agents.label: wave0-mapping
agents.task: Build the mapping core (integration plan step 1): dotted-path extractor over dicts/lists (missing path skips the hit, never crashes) plus field mapper producing normalized SearchResults with original_score == final_score, provider set from the entry name, and metadata carrying engine name + request mode. Rank-decay 1/(rank+1) when no score field is configured. Pure functions, no network, no provider imports.
agents.done: tests/unit/test_http_mapping.py green: nested paths, list indices, missing fields skip hits, rank-decay vs numeric score field, empty payload yields [].

agents.label: wave1-provider
agents.owns: src/openlens/providers/http.py, configs/providers.yaml (append commented http example only), tests/unit/test_http_provider.py
agents.task: Build CustomApiSearchProvider(ExternalSearchProvider) (step 2): config keys endpoint/method/api_key/auth_in/auth_name/params/body/results_path/fields/score, validated in configure with ConfigError on bad shapes (mirror external.py conventions; api_key required when enabled). GET sends params, POST sends fixed JSON body; api_key injected as auth_name header or query param per auth_in. Reuse headers/_fetch/health_check semantics from the base. Register type 'http' in register_builtin_providers via lazy import. Tests stub _fetch (offline-safe): GET/POST wiring, auth placement both modes, dotted-path extraction, bad-config rejection, inherited timeout/error mapping.
agents.done: tests/unit/test_http_provider.py green covering all of the above; provider importable via registry as type 'http'.

agents.done: Extended suites green; http type passes the same conformance bar as bing/opensearch/custom_index.

integrate.label: wave3-integrate
integrate.owns: wiring and fixes anywhere (no new features)
integrate.task: Run the FULL suite 'uv run pytest tests/unit tests/integration' until green, fixing fallout. Then verify manually: point the http provider at a local stub HTTP server returning a foreign payload shape, run one search through the engine, and confirm normalized results with attribution. Report the integration plan's validation checklist with pass/fail per item and the exact test command evidencing each pass.
integrate.done: Full suite green, stub-server verification observed, validation checklist reported.
